status: DOCUMENTARY CHECK ONLY - no loader built or tested

configuration.memory: 2 x H5TQ2G63GFR-TEC, 512 MiB, 32 bit, single rank
configuration.target_status: Request for bring-up; supported PLL step and achieved frequency must be read back from the generated loader and boot log.

findings: Rockchip ddrbin_tool guide explicitly defines ddr3_freq in MHz, not MT/s. RK3566/3568 frequency editing is supported from DDR bin V1.00.
Current RK3568MINIALL.ini points to regular rk3568_ddr_1560MHz_v1.26.bin, rk356x_usbplug_v1.17.bin and rk356x_spl_v1.14.bin. File name alone does not establish the DDR3 frequency used for this board.
Rockchip warns that boards without DQSn pull-ups must use regular DDRBIN. WDQS-specific binaries require560 ohm DQSn pull-ups and are not appropriate for the current schematic.
Hynix TE speed grade is DDR3-2133 (14-14-14), per saved Hynix speed-bin table. The1066 MT/s project target is a conservative bring-up choice, not the component speed limit.
required_evidence: Pin a specific rkbin revision and record binary hashes before use; current master is mutable.
Generate full parameter dump from selected regular DDR binary, modify DDR3 target, dump again and compare. Do not infer default drive/ODT settings from the filename.
Verify UART2 mux0 debug path, voltage sequencing and512 MiB/32-bit/single-rank detection on actual hardware.
Build real Linux kernel/rootfs including AP6256 firmware, gateway/UI/VPN and signed update policy; measure compressed artifact sizes. No assumption that32 MiB supports A/B updates.
Validate SPI-NOR ROM boot, address mode, U-Boot support and USB recovery using the exact W25Q256 variant.
Run memory test, cold/warm starts and load/temperature tests; vendor full-space test is not exhaustive.
